definitions.explanation: The act of ending a national policy of isolation and opening diplomatic and trade relations with foreign countries. Most commonly refers to Japan's opening in the 1850s after the arrival of Commodore Perry.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{幕末|ばくまつ}→幕末：12531_bakumatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{開国|かいこく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Japan opened its doors at the end of the Edo period.

examples.japanese: ペリー⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{来航|らいこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{開国|かいこく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦きっかけ→きっかけ：10309_kikkake⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Perry's arrival became the catalyst for the opening of the country.

examples.japanese: {開国|かいこく}⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{西洋|せいよう}→西洋：01446_seiyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧や⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一気|いっき}→一気：08891_ikki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{流入|りゅうにゅう}した→流入する：21384_ryuunyuu⟧。
examples.english: The opening of the country brought a flood of Western culture and technology.

notes:
Almost always used in the context of Japanese history, specifically the end of the ⟦{鎖国|さこく}→鎖国：14514_sakoku⟧ (national isolation) policy in the 1850s. The opposite is ⟦{鎖国|さこく}→鎖国：14514_sakoku⟧ (closing the country).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {開国|かいこく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to open the country)
- {開国|かいこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迫|せま}る→迫る：03928_semaru⟧ (to demand the opening of a country)
- {開国|かいこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧ (to seek the opening of a country)

ETYMOLOGY:
The debate between {開国|かいこく}⟦{派|は}→派：28356_ha⟧ (pro-opening faction) and {攘夷|じょうい}⟦{派|は}→派：28356_ha⟧ (expel-the-foreigners faction) defined late Edo politics. {開国|かいこく} is now used more broadly to describe any country ending isolation.
